data.title: Spectacular Prototype: Tesla Roadster Set for 2028 Release
data.description: Tesla has put on a big show for the presentation of its new Roadster. However, little remains of the first prototype that Tesla unveiled back in 2017 - neither in terms of design nor technology. Although detailed technical information is still scarce. The presentation focused more on the features realised through a collaboration with SpaceX. However, this has little to do with a road-legal car in Germany.

data.title: New entry-level Cupra Tavascan launched in the UK
data.description: Cupra has expanded its UK Tavascan line-up with the entry-level 'Origin' trim, a smaller 58 kWh battery option, and additional technology features. Prices now start at £39,995, while selected existing versions have also become cheaper.

data.title: Plug-in hybrids emit six times more CO2 than officially stated
data.description: The gap between official and real CO₂ emissions from plug-in hybrids continues to grow. According to a new analysis by Transport & Environment, PHEVs emitted on average about six times more CO₂ under real-world conditions in 2024 than official figures suggest.

data.title: Astra Electric: Opel introduces new base version for €36,490
data.description: Opel is reducing the base list prices for its Astra lineup - by introducing the new 'Astra Start' equipment variant. As a result, the entry price for the Astra Electric has dropped by €1,900 - to €36,490. Customers will, however, have to do without features such as a heat pump.

data.title: Fastned increases charging revenue and accelerates network expansion
data.description: Fastned significantly increased its charging revenue in the third quarter of 2026 during a period of rapid expansion. The fast-charging provider commissioned 17 new stations, secured 26 additional locations, and currently has 65 stations under construction.

data.title: Great Han: BYD launches 5.26-metre battery-electric saloon
data.description: BYD is launching its new electric flagship sedan, the Da Han EV - a.k.a the Great Han - in China. For years, BYD has positioned the sedan as a premium model alongside the E-SUV BYD Tang, which was also rebranded as the "Great Tang" this summer.

data.title: 20 electric trucks from Germany for Belgian logistics firm H.Essers
data.description: The logistics company H.Essers, based in Genk, Belgium, is expanding its electric fleet with 20 new electric trucks. MAN and Mercedes-Benz Trucks have each delivered ten units. They will now be primarily deployed from the company's Belgian locations.

data.title: Rhenus deploys 51 Mercedes eSprinter vans for last-mile delivery
data.description: Rhenus expands its electric fleet with 51 Mercedes-Benz eSprinter. The vans, equipped with 81-kWh batteries and box bodies by Junge Fahrzeugbau, will be deployed nationwide for home delivery services.

data.title: VW prepares battery recall for multiple ID. models in Europe
data.description: Volkswagen is preparing a recall of several electric series in Germany and other European markets due to potential defects in high-voltage battery cells. As a precaution, they recommend that affected vehicles should only be charged up to 80 per cent.

data.title: Tesla’s plans for Grünheide expansion take shape
data.description: Plans for the expansion of Tesla's German Gigafactory in Grünheide are becoming clearer. According to media reports, the US electric car manufacturer intends to significantly expand the site over the coming years - with a new, much larger production hall and additional infrastructure.

data.title: Green SM deploys its first electric taxis in the U.S.
data.description: A little over a month after entering Europe, Vietnamese electric ride-hailing service provider Green SM has expanded into North America, beginning with the US. This is the VinFast affiliate's ninth market globally.

data.title: Porsche Cayenne S Coupé Electric test: The PPE has moved a step further
data.description: 390 kW at the fast charger, 16 minutes from ten to 80 per cent, and a chassis that confidently and surprisingly calmly handles over two and a half tons around corners: The Porsche Cayenne S Coupé Electric promises fast stages and short breaks. In the test, it becomes clear how far Porsche has developed the PPE for this purpose – and why the noise level deserves closer attention during charging.

data.title: Citroën reimagines the 2CV Fourgonnette as a BEV
data.description: At the 2026 Paris Motor Show, Citroën is unveiling the 2CV Fourgonnette Concept, an electric reinterpretation of its iconic "boxy duck." The study builds on the equally new 2CV Concept, transferring its idea of a simple, lightweight, and relatively affordable electric car to a compact utility vehicle. However, there are no concrete plans for production as of yet.

data.title: Japan: Suzuki prices e Sky below BYD & Honda’s electric kei cars
data.description: Suzuki has announced the starting price of the e Sky in Japan. The brand's first electric kei car will start at 2.12 million yen (~€12,000 euros), undercutting rivals from BYD and Honda. Sales are set to commence on 16 November.

data.title: Q-Park expands collaboration with software provider Greenflux
data.description: Parking operator Q-Park is expanding its collaboration with Greenflux at its locations in Germany and Ireland. Previously, 1,700 charging stations at Q-Park sites in the Netherlands were successfully migrated to Greenflux's software system. This means Q-Park will now independently operate its parking garage charging stations at additional locations and no longer rely on third-party providers for controlling and billing charging processes.

data.title: DHL Freight deploys SuperPanther eTopas 600 in daily operations
data.description: DHL Freight has moved the first SuperPanther eTopas 600 produced in Europe out of testing and into regular commercial operation. The battery-electric heavy-duty truck has been operating out of the Netherlands and traveling to Belgium since September, covering approx. 2,000 km per week.

data.title: Tesla expands Supercharger network along South Korean highways
data.description: Tesla is expanding its Supercharger network in South Korea. As part of a program by the Korea Expressway Corporation, new fast-charging locations will be built at 21 highway rest areas.

data.title: Michelin launches EV Charge for European fleets
data.description: Michelin Connected Fleet has introduced Michelin EV Charge, a new charging solution for corporate fleets. In collaboration with Deftpower, the company is consolidating access to over 1.2 million charging points, billing, and telematics data on a single platform.

data.title: ‘Major’ OEM to test Gelion’s NES cathode platform
data.description: Gelion has signed an agreement with an unnamed major automaker to test its sulphur-based 'Nano Encapsulated Sulfur' cathode technology. The OEM will evaluate the material in cells with liquid and solid electrolytes, as well as with lithium-metal and graphite anodes.

data.title: Changan and CATL to expand battery capacity to 75 GWh
data.description: Changan and CATL want to significantly deepen their collaboration. In addition to expanding their joint battery cell capacity to 75 GWh, the partners also plan closer cooperation on solid-state and sodium-ion batteries.
